sorular.soru: TO WHOM IT MAY CONCERN, This is to certify that Mr.Walden has worked on board the “ BEAUTY ” as a captain since 1995 . He has specialized in the Far Eastern container trade. Owing to his great experience in handling the refrigerated goods, we found him and his services very useful and we can recommend him to be employed on any vessel. He is leaving us at his request and we are sorry to lose him. The MASTER OF THE M/V “BEAUTY” This is an example of a ...........
“Underway” and “making way” ……………………………………..
siklar: are no different from each other

sorular.soru: Visibility is reduced by fog.
Visiul coded signals and radio-telegraphy signals are printed in ………………………
Watertight bulkheads do not …………………………………………………….
siklar: prevent odours from passing from one compartment to another.
prevent leakage between the two adjacent compartments.
divide the vessel into longitudinal subdivisions.
store fresh water or ballast water.

sorular.soru: What association below is not true?
What is the function of Navtex device on board?
siklar: It receives only news on sea meteorology and records them.
It receives only navigational warnings and records them.
It receives navigational and meteorological news and records them.
According to the information transmitted from shore – based radar stations, it always indicates the position of the vessel.
If the position of the vessel is filled up in it, it always indicates the position of the vessel.

When the engine refuses to start, which of the following situations cannot be a reason?
siklar: Air in fuel line or pump

sorular.soru: When the second mate caught a contagious disease .................................
siklar: the doctor advised him to stop complaining
he was taken out of the sick bay as soon as possible
the crew lost hope when his condition worsened
no one was allowed to visit him
the doctor gave him a check up and found nothing

Particulars of the illness and the results of the examination of the ill person,

siklar: What you have said is not understandable
